id.description: Id for the given snapshot - format: subjectType + "#" + snapshotId

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

description.description: A human readable description of what data is stored in this snapshot

subjects.description:
An array of {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot.Subject}s this snapshot captured. Each snapshot subject refers to one single
{@link FeatureEvaluatable} instance based on its subjectId. The referenced {@link FeatureEvaluatable} instances are
filtered by the {@link CreateSnapshotSpec.subjectFilter} or the {@link CreateSnapshotSpec.subjects} passed by users
during feature evaluation. Since Feature.Set.Snapshot is immutable once created, so this field is also immutable.
see {@link FeatureEvaluatable.evalFeatureSetBatch} and {@link FeatureEvaluatable.evalFeaturesBatch}

featureSet.description: {@link Feature.Set} captured by this snapshot during evaluation

featureFingerprint.description: The {@link Feature.Set#featureFingerprint featureFingerprint} of the FeatureSet that is used to create this snapshot

models.description: ML models that used this snapshot for training

start.description: Start time of the snapshot. It's the same as {@link CreateSnapshotSpec#start}.

end.description: End time of the snapshot. It's the same as {@link CreateSnapshotSpec#end}.

name: Feature.Set.Snapshot
